mathematical_result.unit_classification: Every VariableChange over Z has scale 1 or -1 and is a translation or Y-sign composed with a translation.
mathematical_result.all_integral_changes: Every integral Mathlib variable change constructs a GeometricFiberPort at every prime and preserves full finite point counts.
mathematical_result.discriminant: The integral discriminant is exactly invariant because the only scaling units are plus or minus one.

mathematical_result.preserved_observations: Prime, count, residue, exponent, Frobenius trace, every direct Euler coefficient, local reciprocal factors, finite Euler products and complete ordered signed trace packets.
